description: Buy event ticket(s) via mobile money on behalf of a real guest — check_event_availability shows what is left. Initiates a real charge; the guest approves it on their own phone (a prompt appears on the mobileNumber given), the ticket issues once payment confirms. Card payment isn't supported here; check_event_availability returns a cardCheckoutUrl for that.

mobileNumber.description: The guest's own mobile money number — they will need to approve the charge on this phone

name: buy_ticket
title: Buy an event ticket
